default.description: Freeze environment as measured 2026-11-22: Python 3.13, no CQ_HECS_BUILD_DIR, no PYTHONPATH to the native extension, no optional extras, no web/node_modules. Same as the top-level 'reasons'.

with_native.description: Python 3.14 (matches the cp314 native extension) + native Vulkan build (cmake -G 'Visual Studio 17 2022' -A x64 -DCQ_ENABLE_VULKAN=ON, Release) exported as CQ_HECS_BUILD_DIR and on PYTHONPATH, qiskit-ibm-runtime and web/node_modules present, CQ_HECS_EXE unset, no external proof checkers, no python-sat. Native-dependent reasons are intentionally ABSENT (budget 0): any native skip fails the gate.

justifications.CQ_HECS_EXE not set: Opt-in smoke test of the PyInstaller onedir exe (scripts/build_exe.ps1 -> dist/cq-hecs/cq-hecs.exe). NOT_RUN in both environments until the exe lane is built; the native cq_hecs.exe is a different program and must NOT be used for CQ_HECS_EXE.
justifications.collection skipped: tests/test_sat_certificates.py and tests/test_sat_external.py importorskip pysat (python-sat optional extra); known Windows/Py3.14 external abort, see AGENTS_V7 / GEMINI_HANDOFF.
justifications.native (all 9 reasons): Environmental: no native build dir was exported (CQ_HECS_BUILD_DIR) in the default environment. These 116 skips are budgeted ONLY in the default environment; in 'with_native' they must be 0 (verified, see evidence/waveE_E5.md: 691 passed, 0 skipped).
Default (freeze, py3.13) environment had no web/node_modules; Studio plan UI test is NOT_RUN there. Present (and passing) in the with_native environment run.
justifications.optional: tests/test_schema_contracts.py openapi validator extra not installed.
justifications.qiskit-ibm-runtime not installed: Default (freeze, py3.13) interpreter lacks the extra; the 4 Aer from_backend oracle tests passed under the py3.14 interpreter that has it.
justifications.set CQ_CAKE_LPR / CQ_DRAT_TRIM / CQ_LRAT: Optional external proof checkers (cake_lpr, drat-trim, lrat-check) are not installed; the corresponding trust levels stay NOT_RUN, never PASS.

notes: The total is not a single number to raise: each reason is budgeted per environment. Reconciled in research/v7/evidence/waveE_E5.md (supersedes the 105 recorded earlier, which predated the native/CLI-hardening test files).
